chapter_title: Multimedia Storyboarding and AI Asset Generation
title: Storyboard Frames as Claims
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting storyboard frames as claims to storyboard frame sequence with narration, signaling, and reader-action notes, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Convert a descriptive storyboard caption into a four-slot frame claim: prior state, predicted action with a learner verb, warrant tying a feature to a Mayer or cognitive-load principle, and disconfirming evidence.
Apply the three falsifiability tests (action, warrant, disconfirmation) to diagnose a frame claim.
Verify claim-chaining so that frame N's predicted action becomes frame N+1's prior state.
Judge an AI suggestion against the warrant standard, accepting or rejecting it with a stated reason.
